name: research-skills
description: Research workflow skills: sharpen ideas, run audited theory searches, read arxiv papers, write rigorous reports and papers, and operate a deployed PLI GPU pool.

interface.longDescription: Six top-level skills covering the research loop: sharpen a vague idea into a falsifiable project contract and prediction-annotated roadmap, launch audited multi-agent theory searches, read arxiv papers from TeX source, write rigorous experiment reports with QA-checked PDFs, plan, draft, revise, simplify, or audit research papers, and operate an already deployed shared PLI/Della GPU pool through its canonical CLI and ledger.
defaultPrompt: Sharpen this vague idea into a project contract and experiment roadmap.
Research this problem with theory agents and relevant arxiv papers.
Turn my experiment artifacts and research results into a rigorous report or paper.
